title: The Truth of Mo Xiansheng
next_chapter_hook: The warm and smooth Jade Pendant lay quietly in Mo Xiansheng's palm, as if having traveled through decades of time, returning to its true owner once more...

text.content: The cold wind blew through the hall, and Chen Ji felt as if all the blood in his body was about to freeze. 'Father's death was no accident'—these seven words were like a dull blade cutting flesh, carving away at the softest spot in his heart. Three years had passed, and he thought he had long sealed that pain away in the deepest corner, only to have it torn open by someone's words today, revealing the wound still bleeding profusely beneath.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted gently in the air, those eyes that had witnessed countless vicissitudes seemed capable of seeing through all of Chen Ji's disguises. He spoke slowly, his voice low like an ancient well's depths: 'I know the turmoil in your heart, but do you understand, for these hundreds of years, I have been waiting for you?' The remnant soul shimmered with a faint silver light, as if responding to some ancient summoning, 'I am the disciple of the original master of the Tianji Record—Mo Chen.'

text.content: Chen Jiabruptly抬头，眼中闪过一丝难以置信。初代主人的弟子？那岂不是说，墨先生与他父亲、与天机录初代之间横亘着数百年的时光长河？他的呼吸不自觉地加重了几分，脑中飞速运转——如果此人真是那个时代的遗留者，那他所知之事，恐怕远比自己想象的还要恐怖。

dialogue.content: 'Indeed.' Mo Xiansheng seemed to read his doubts, and a bitter smile appeared on that aged face. 'I watched with my own eyes as each generation of record-keepers walked the same path of doom, and I watched as they were crushed one by one by the so-called Heavenly Will. Your father Chen Tianming was the most recent one—and also the one closest to breaking the game.'

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace grew warm, as if sensing something. He stared intently at the figure within the silver light, his hands unconsciously clenching into fists. For a spirit from hundreds of years ago to speak his father's name so solemnly—what did it mean? Opportunity, or a deeper trap? He, Chen Ji, had been scheming across the world for so long, and understood one principle best—there's no such thing as kindness without reason.

dialogue.content: 'You must have doubts.' Mo Xiansheng was not angered by his silence, but instead became even more peaceful. 'You think the Heavenly Eye is the master of this realm? You're wrong.' His remnant soul shuddered violently, the silver light blazing brightly, 'It's merely a surveillance tool cast by a higher existence—in its eyes, record-keepers like you are merely chess pieces waiting to be harvested—yet the true master...'

text.content: Before the words could finish, Chen Ji felt the surrounding temperature plummet, an icy chill crawling from his tailbone to the back of his skull. He had witnessed the Heavenly Eye's might, an existence he currently could in no way resist—yet Mo Xiansheng claimed it was merely a tool? At this moment, he finally understood why every Tianji Record keeper throughout history met tragic ends, because their opponents were never at the level they had assumed.

dialogue.content: 'The true master lurks in higher dimensions, not meddling in mortal affairs, using only the Heavenly Eye as its eyes and ears to monitor every creature attempting to peer into Heavenly Secrets.' A hint of madness flashed in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. 'And the complete Tianji Record...is sealed within the core of the Heavenly Eye—the deepest part of the trial you're about to enter.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words exploded like thunder, yet in that fleeting moment of inspiration, Chen Ji suppressed all emotional turmoil. He knew too well—the more earth-shattering the truth, the more likely it was to be the most lethal trap. But equally, the other side of truth often hides the greatest leverage for reversal. He took a deep breath and looked at that swaying silver light.

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng had already revealed so many secrets; turning hostile now would serve no purpose. Better to go along with the flow and see exactly what筹码 he intends to offer.
choices.visible_cost: May expose more information to unknown enemies
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence and plan ahead
choices.risk_hint: Completely trusting a remnant soul from hundreds of years ago—isn't that too reckless?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly loosened his clenched fists, his expressioncalm得近乎cold："Since the gentleman is willing to speak, Chen Ji will listen." His voice held not a trace of fluctuation, as if discussing today's weather. "Only please don't blame me for measuring a君子's heart with a小人's—my memory is too good, and my grudges are remembered all too clearly."

choices.description: A remnant soul from hundreds of years ago suddenly appears claiming I'm the chosen one? Such stories sound like traps from folktales. Don't fully believe, but don't fully doubt either.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the initiative, not led by the nose
choices.risk_hint: If what Mo Xiansheng says is true, refusing his help could lead to a dead end in the trial
choices.process_label: retreat to advance, test their hand

text.content: A faint smile of amusement curled on Chen Ji's lips: "Mo Xiansheng speaks with such grand口气. An old relic from hundreds of years ago, a disciple of the original master..." He paused, his tone turning sharply cold. "Such origins—if told to those old monsters of Tianqing Sect, they'd likely be scared out of their wits. But this Chen Ji has always only believed what his own eyes have seen."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng upon hearing this did not get angry; instead, he let out a low laugh. That laughter carried too many complex emotions—relief, bitterness, and an indescribable sense of release: "Good, good—a man who only believes what his own eyes see. You truly are of the same vein as Tianming—he too was this suspicious back then, yet also understood better than anyone how to assess the situation."

text.content: When Chen Ji heard his father's name, his eyelids twitched slightly. He did not respond, merely waiting in silence for what came next. Mo Xiansheng said his father was "closest to breaking the game"—was this sincere intent or hidden scheme? He understood human nature too well—the closer someone tries to draw you in, the more one must be cautious. Of course, he also did not forget to note this debt: when this was all over, regardless of whether Mo Xiansheng was friend or foe, he would demand every word spoken today be accounted for.

dialogue.content: "You need not be so guarded." Mo Xiansheng sighed as if in helplessness. "I'm but a remnant soul, and all I seek is to draw a close to these hundreds of years of waiting." His gaze fell upon the faintly glowing fragment in Chen Ji's embrace. "The complete Tianji Record is sealed within the core of the Heavenly Eye. There are two ways to retrieve it—one, forcefully break through using Heavenly Fate Value; the second..."

text.content: Chen Ji敏锐地捕捉到了那个未说完的"其二"。他心念电转，已然推演出数种可能。以力破力是最笨的法子，他现在的fate根本经不起那般消耗——那天机录残页传来的感知，他比谁都清楚自己如今的家底。那第二条路，才是墨先生真正要说的，也是他布下这一切的真正目的。

dialogue.content: "The second method is to use the record-keeper's blood to activate the inheritance resonance, bypassing the Heavenly Eye's surveillance and directly touching the sealed core." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew increasingly low. "But this requires the record-keeper to have sufficiently deep bloodline connection with the original master—do you think I chose you for no reason?" In the silver light, his gaze burned like a torch. "Because you are Chen Tianming's son, the sole bloodline inheritor of the Tianji Record in this realm."

choice.prompt: Truth crashed over Chen Ji like a tide, yet at this moment he found himself strangely calm. He remembered his father gripping his hand before death, remembered the loneliness of those nights spent alone deducing Heavenly Secrets, and remembered all the opponents he had crushed beneath his feet along the way. Bloodline inheritance—so from the very beginning, he had never been fighting alone. He slowly raised his head, looking at that silver light.

choices.description: Since fate has arranged things thus, Chen Ji will accept this chess game. His father's遗志, he will accomplish.
choices.visible_reward: Possibility of obtaining the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Blood resonance may bypass surveillance, but it also means direct conflict with the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content: Chen Ji沉默良久，终于slowly开口，声音带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖："父亲他……临终前，可曾留下什么话？"这便是他选择接受的信号——他不再追问动机，不再doubting真假，因为有些事情，不需要理由。

choices.description: Since the gentleman says I cannot afford the price, then please tell me clearly what this cost is. Better to say the ugly words upfront than to settle accounts later.
choices.risk_hint: Some truths, once known, leave no way back

dialogue.content: Chen Ji目光冷冽，直视那团银芒："先生方才说代价我承受不起，既如此，何不直言相告？我陈机虽然惜命，却也不是听不得坏话的人。"他没有动，但周身气势已然不同——这是谈判的姿态，不是臣服。

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul paused momentarily, as if touched by Chen Ji's words. After a brief moment, he sighed long and deeply: "You truly are like him...having already made a choice, yet still asking clearly where the blade will fall." The silver light swayed gently, and his voice became extremely solemn. "That cost is your Heavenly Fate—once the complete Tianji Record is unsealed, the Heavenly Eye will lock onto you, and you will endure the karmic backlash of all previous record-keepers."

text.content: Chen Ji's瞳孔suddenly收缩。历代执笔者的因果反噬——那意味着什么？意味着他将要承受数百年来所有试图窥探天机者的命数余烬。天道之眼不会坐视threatening存在，它会倾尽全力将他碾杀。而他唯一能依仗的，不过是天机录残页那少得可怜的能力，以及……身边那些或真心或假意的盟友。

dialogue.content: "But you are not without a chance of victory." Mo Xiansheng's tone shifted, and a trace of warmth actually emerged from the remnant soul. "Your father left in haste back then, and there was one thing he didn't have time to pass to you." As he spoke, a warm jade pendant slowly emerged from the silver light. That pendant was pure white throughout, its surface faintly flowing with patterns identical to the Tianji Record—those were the unique marks of the Chen bloodline.

text.content: Chen Ji's breathing came to a complete halt at this moment. He recognized this jade pendant—deep in his childhood memories, his father had countless times played with this item beneath the lamp, his expression sometimes grave, sometimes melancholic, yet never telling him what it was. He had thought it long buried with his father, never expecting it to reappear before his eyes in such a manner. His eyes grew slightly moist, but he quickly suppressed that emotion and reached out to receive the jade pendant. The coolness upon touching it was like his father's palm's final warmth.

dialogue.content: "This is the Heavenly Fate Jade Pendant, crafted by your father with his life's essence as a protective artifact." Mo Xiansheng's voice became extremely gentle. "It can briefly shield Heavenly perception, granting you crucial time during the trial." The silver light gradually dimmed, and the remnant soul's form also began to fade. "This is all I can do...the road ahead, you must walk yourself. Remember, your sister Chen Nian's existence will interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight—finding her may be the key to breaking the game."

text.content: After speaking these final words, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul completely scattered, leaving only that jade pendant quietly resting in Chen Ji's palm, emanating a soft glow. Silence as deep as death returned to the surroundings, save only for the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace flickering in the darkness. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to this relic that had crossed decades of time to return, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. Father's death was indeed no accident. And he, Chen Ji, since entering this game, would play it until heaven and earth collapse.
